title: V2 独立统计审查设计
timing: Written after V2 completion was visible, before this audit opened V2 test NPZ; V2 itself is an extension initiated after partial V1 development results.
strong_baseline: Secondary validation-selected comparator from RW, drift, ridge_price, ridge_full, HGB, GRU, LSTM using V2 past validation only; not a substitute for the five core contrasts.
summary: Equal two-market/two-year/three-horizon mean of seed-average MSE divided by same-cell RW MSE. Seeds17/29/43 measure algorithm randomness, not independent samples.

bootstrap.method: Paired synchronous circular calendar blocks across GZ/HB within each year; same date multiplicities for candidate, all controls and RW denominator; reestimate denominator in each replicate.
bootstrap.intervals: Marginal95% and99% Bonferroni intervals for the five fixed core contrasts. No adjustment for previous study search or development-conditioned model design.
bootstrap.seeds: Fold seed losses within each origin before time resampling.

integrity: Verify all4 frozen source hashes, completion, 44 NPZ files, 120 neural task receipts.
Reconstruct target arrays, index masks, scale/weighted loss, EIA14day historical alignment independently.
Rebuild current volume surprise only from current reported volume and strictly preceding60targetrecords; verify source hashes/date match/counts/missing flag.
Verify each family actual native-forward epoch selection through frozen common runner and receipt replay; no model fitting.
Check chosen LR and epoch, seed labels, final epochs, positive gradient logs, checkpoint bytes.
For reused v1constant prove identical origins, observed arrays, horizons and input source hashes in corresponding4cells.
Keep V1 and V2 populations separate; do not pool eight and four cells.
limitation: Current author-reported volume assumes availability after that day's report; publication timestamp/vintage and units not certified. Price-only ridge remains a deliberate price-only control; full ridge/HGB/recurrent models see added volume.
